validationReport.statement: PDF file is not compliant with Validation Profile requirements.

rule.description: The value of the Length key specified in the stream dictionary shall match the number of bytes in the file following the LINE FEED character after the stream keyword and preceding the EOL marker before the endstream keyword

check.errorMessage: Actual length of the stream (449 byte(s)) does not match the value of the Length key in the Stream dictionary (450 byte(s))

rule.description: The document catalog dictionary of a conforming file shall contain the Metadata key. The metadata stream dictionary shall contain entry Type with value /Metadata and entry Subtype with value /XML

check.errorMessage: The document catalog dictionary doesn't contain metadata key or metadata stream dictionary does not contain either entry Type with value /Metadata or entry Subtype with value /XML
